phase_name: Script skeleton, CLI, and the two handoff gates (WORK a)

objectives.description: Create orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh with header, two-engine contract, MUST-NOT list, output field list
Copy orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's flag-parser shape (usage heredoc, case loop, --help, required-flag validation)
Accept the enumerated flag set plus recorded-deviation --dispatch-seq/--dispatch-start-ts/--command-suffix
Derive multi-state path identically to orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh
Implement dispatch_seq identity gate with WARN-degrade on absent field
Route defect recording through system-defect-record.sh + skill_orchestrate_append_detected_defect against the resolved defect store
Emit provisional output JSON line; hand-verify both gates against a sandbox fixture

deviations.description: Accept exactly the flag set the plan enumerates for orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh
deviations.reason: Neither engine persists a per-cycle dispatch_seq/dispatch_start_ts value the script could derive without new flags: single-task mode threads them as orchestrator-turn-local shell variables (never written to the loop guard file), and multi-task mode persists them per-task in the multi-state file but the plan's flag list did not name a way to pass an override or exercise the gate outside that file. Added --dispatch-seq, --dispatch-start-ts (optional; multi-task derives from the multi-state file when omitted) and --command-suffix (mirrors the single-task Tier C message parameter). Documented at length in the script's own header.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added --dispatch-seq/--dispatch-start-ts/--command-suffix flags, absent from this literal enumeration, because neither single-task engine persists a per-cycle dispatch_seq/dispatch_start_ts anywhere for this script to derive them from; see the script's own header for the full rationale and the graceful-degradation fallback)*

deviations.description: Preserve the two distinct detecting-site suffixes (:stale-handoff, :dispatch-seq-mismatch)
deviations.reason: Used :cycle-postflight-stale-handoff / :cycle-postflight-dispatch-seq-mismatch instead of the single-task engine's own :stale-handoff/:dispatch-seq-mismatch suffixes, so this script's own detecting sites remain distinguishable from SKILL.md's still-live inline gates until Phase 7's cutover removes them (both scripts and inline gates coexist until then, each attributed to the same SKILL.md path).
